tarren_mill_sluice_keeper: Pate. Sluice-keeper. This is the Weir, the north end of Tarren Mill, where the race comes off the river. The crank is mine. Drop the gate and the wheel stops, the Society's vats go cold, and everyone on both banks remembers my name.
tarren_mill_chaplain: Chaplain Ewen Blackwood. I keep the chapel on the west bank, the village side. The Forsaken across the race have never asked me to stop. I have never asked them why. We bury our own and they do whatever it is they do.
tarren_mill_farmhand: Dorrin. I work the plots at the north-west of the village. Barley in the north rows, oats in the south. Same as my mother sowed. The dead hold the town and they still want bread baked, so I still sow.
tarren_mill_scout: Scout Mirren Vask. I report to the Commander, here on the east bank. Durnholde, south-east of town, is thick with Syndicate, and the hills on the way are thick with gnolls. Walk the road, and count what you see for me.
tarren_mill_commander: Commander Vellis Thorne. I hold Tarren Mill for the Dark Lady from the east bank. Alterac to the north, Southshore to the south-west, and the Syndicate at Durnholde in between. We hold the middle. I have a writ that says the valley is mine to act in. I intend to use it.
tarren_mill_flight_master: Ghulrak, wind-rider. The roost is in the Mill Yard, west bank. Hillsbrad from the air is all fences. You do not see how much of it is fences until you are over it. I fly north to the Undercity and anywhere else you have walked.
tarren_mill_miller: Aldous Reed, miller. The wheel in the Mill Yard is mine to mind. It has turned every day for sixty years. Who holds the town has never once stopped it - not Lordaeron, not the plague, not the Society across the water.
tarren_mill_apprentice: Nilla Stitch, apprentice to the Society. This is the Apothecarium, the east bank. I label everything. If a jar has no label, do not open it, and do not tell me you opened it.
tarren_mill_watchman: Watchman Grell. I have the south bridge, between the village and the Apothecarium. Three bridges, and one of us on each. You would be amazed how many try the water anyway.
tarren_mill_farrier: Nell Marsh, farrier. Mill Row, the south-west corner of the village. Hooves and hinges. Half this town runs on things I hammered flat, and the other half has not got hooves any more.
tarren_mill_stablemaster: Brann Teague, stablemaster. The stalls are at the west end of Mill Row. Horses will not cross the bridges at night. Clever animals, horses. Leave yours with me and it stays on this bank.
tarren_mill_gate_guard: Hollis. South gate - the only way in or out of Tarren Mill. State your business, keep to the road, and do not swim the race. The village is the west bank, the Society is the east, and the bridges are how you tell them apart.
